user_observation: Returned exactly to starting location; no surveyed ground truth or heading confirmation
window_method: Median first 2 s versus stationary standing 65–85 s after first SLAM pose; later lying down excluded. Window identified from native pose stability and recorded factory velocity/height.
floor_method: Raw clouds sampled every 16 frames; body extrinsics; RANSAC lower plane then SVD, 2.5 cm inliers, >=50 points; normals transformed by saved body poses. Plane identification heuristic, not ground truth.
interpretation: Large return-position drift exists in native Jetson frontend and persists after backend optimization. This is not explained by Wi-Fi/RViz display. Factory position is a diagnostic reference, not ground truth and not fused.
archive: Finalized inputs/map/trajectory transferred to laptop; Jetson copy removed by session archival.
